control_socket_path.description: Unix socket path for the Kea DHCP control socket.

hooks_lease_file_path.description: Path to the hooks library for lease file updates (e.g., CSV lease file logging).

items.description: Network interface names to bind the DHCP server to (e.g., eth0, br0).

interfaces.description: List of network interfaces the DHCP server will listen on.

interface_re_detect.description: If true, Kea will re-detect interfaces periodically; usually false in stable environments.

lease_database_type.description: Type of backend for storing lease data. 'memfile' stores leases in CSV files; 'mysql'/'postgresql' use relational databases.

lease_database_name.description: Name of the database (for SQL backends) or path to lease CSV file (for 'memfile').

lease_database_user.description: Database user with access to the lease database (used when lease_database_type is mysql/postgresql).

lease_database_password.description: Password for the lease database user (used when lease_database_type is mysql/postgresql).

lease_database_host.description: Database server hostname (used when lease_database_type is mysql/postgresql).

lease_database_port.description: Database server port (used when lease_database_type is mysql/postgresql).

lease_file_cleanup_interval.description: Interval in seconds between lease file cleanup cycles (used when lease_database_type is 'memfile').

data.description: Option data as string (comma-separated for multi-values).

dhcp_option_data.description: Global DHCP options to include in responses (e.g., DNS servers, domain name).

id.description: Unique subnet ID (must be unique across subnets).

pools.description: List of address pools in this subnet.

valid_lifetime.description: Default lease lifetime in seconds (must be ≥ min and ≤ max).

renew_timer.description: T1 renewal timer in seconds; defaults to 50% of valid_lifetime if omitted.

rebind_timer.description: T2 rebind timer in seconds; defaults to 80% of valid_lifetime if omitted.

reservations.description: Static host reservations in this subnet.

subnets.description: List of IPv4 subnets to serve. Each subnet defines pools, options, and reservations.

server_id_type.description: Algorithm used to generate server identifier (Hardware MAC-based is standard for DHCPv4).

server_id_value.description: Explicit server identifier value (usually left blank and auto-generated when server_id_type='hardware').

default_valid_lifetime.description: Global default lease lifetime in seconds for clients not covered by per-subnet values.

default_renew_timer.description: Global default T1 renewal timer (fraction of valid_lifetime).

default_rebind_timer.description: Global default T2 rebind timer (fraction of valid_lifetime).

log_severity.description: Log severity for Kea DHCP4 process.

log_global_severity.description: Global log severity (overrides per-logger if set).

log_flush.description: If true, flush log after each write (useful for debugging, may impact performance).

log_max_size.description: Maximum log file size in bytes before rotation (e.g., 10 MB).

log_max_ver.description: Maximum number of rotated log files to retain.

log_debuglevel.description: Debug verbosity level (0–99); only used in DEBUG mode.

log_global_debuglevel.description: Global debug level (overrides per-logger if set).
